title: Hennessy claims Cheney visited S4

tellings.quote: claimed he worked at S4 and sometime in the the mid9s that Dick Cheney came into S4.

plain: A man named Derek Hennessy claimed he worked at S4, a secret facility in Nevada, and that sometime in the mid-1990s Dick Cheney came in to visit it. An online researcher who goes by UAPGerb repeats this to Michels without naming where he heard it. If true, it would put a senior political figure inside a site said to be at the centre of the UFO secret.
